step1: 1- First, after transferring the NFT to the destination wallet, enter your destination wallet and change the network to Polygon MainNet.
step2: 2- Then go to the Import NFT section.
step3: 3- In this section, enter the Artina contract in the contract address section.
step4: 4- Then in the Token ID section, enter the desired token number.
step5: 5- Finally, click on the Import option to transfer your NFT to the destination wallet.
